$comment: MVP 1C durable-shadow-persistence acceptance scenarios. Each maps to executable tests in tests/test_durable_persistence.py and tests/test_durable_demo.py. Execution remains DISABLED in every scenario.

scenarios.given: a fresh durable store
scenarios.expect: opens with the supported schema_version + DURABLE_SHADOW_REFERENCE classification

scenarios.given: a store whose stored schema_version is newer
scenarios.expect: reopen fails closed with SchemaIncompatibleError

scenarios.given: committed records/events
scenarios.expect: UPDATE/DELETE on records or events is refused by append-only triggers

scenarios.given: the same record id + identical content re-committed
scenarios.expect: put_if_absent is idempotent (no duplicate, no error)

scenarios.given: the same record id + differing content
scenarios.expect: RecordCollisionError (append-only violation)

scenarios.given: a failure injected at after_records / after_event / before_commit
scenarios.expect: the whole stage rolls back; no records, events, or index row become visible

scenarios.given: a successful stage commit
scenarios.expect: records + one event + the workflow index update commit atomically

scenarios.given: a sequence of stage commits
scenarios.expect: each event links to the previous event fingerprint; the first links to GENESIS

scenarios.given: an event that does not link to the last event
scenarios.expect: EventChainError (broken previous linkage)

scenarios.given: a fully-run workflow reopened after restart
scenarios.expect: RECOVERED_COMPLETE; execution_status DISABLED; no explicit action required

scenarios.given: a partial workflow reopened by a new service instance
scenarios.expect: RECOVERED_PENDING at the last committed state; requires explicit action; no auto-transition

scenarios.given: a caller-supplied newer head sha
scenarios.expect: RECOVERED_STALE (stale artifact); no external call made

scenarios.given: an unknown revision
scenarios.expect: REFERENCE_MISSING

scenarios.given: any recovery outcome
scenarios.expect: execution stays DISABLED; recovery never resumes external side effects

scenarios.given: a workflow persisted for tenant A
scenarios.expect: reads/reconstruction under tenant B return nothing / INCOMPLETE

scenarios.given: a complete persisted chain
scenarios.expect: COMPLETE with verified event_chain + execution_disabled + all linked records

scenarios.given: a record whose stored payload was mutated (raw DB access)
scenarios.expect: INTEGRITY_FAILURE (fingerprint recomputation catches the tamper)

scenarios.given: a newer current head sha
scenarios.expect: STALE

scenarios.given: a complete persisted chain
scenarios.expect: an exported bundle verifies entirely offline (no store connection)

scenarios.given: a bundle exported twice from the same store
scenarios.expect: identical bundle_fingerprint (deterministic over the persisted content)

scenarios.given: a bundle whose payload was mutated post-export
scenarios.expect: offline verification fails (fingerprint mismatch)

scenarios.given: a bundle with an unknown bundle_version
scenarios.expect: verification refuses it

scenarios.given: a payload field named like a credential/secret/PII
scenarios.expect: ProhibitedFieldError (fail closed); persisted payloads contain no such fields

scenarios.given: a naive (tz-unaware) datetime in a payload
scenarios.expect: ProhibitedFieldError

scenarios.given: the same change event ingested twice
scenarios.expect: same change fingerprint; no new durable records

scenarios.given: durable mode enabled
scenarios.expect: execution_status() == DISABLED; no merge()/execute(); chain carries the execution-disabled marker

scenarios.given: the default (in-memory) service
scenarios.expect: durable_store is None; durable operations raise; existing behavior unchanged

scenarios.given: identical record content in different key order
scenarios.expect: identical payload + envelope fingerprints (content-addressed)
